description: A Few Months to Go! Election Day, is almost here! As we get closer to the next legislative session, I’ve already started working on legislation, with a major focus on something I care deeply about: expanding access to quality, affordable healthcare for Nevadans. I’ve been meeting with doctors, nurses, hospital administrators, healthcare educators, coalitions, and people throughout our healthcare system to hear what we’re doing well and should expand, and where there are gaps we need to address. I want to bring real-world experience and practical solutions to Carson City, not just make promises.
title: Assembly District 35 September Newsletter!
